definitions.explanation: Work done in a garden or yard, such as weeding, planting, pruning, mowing, and general maintenance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{庭仕事|にわしごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I do garden work on weekends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暖|あたた}かく→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{庭仕事|にわしごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しく→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{庭仕事|にわしごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{日課|にっか}→日課：00317_nikka⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

notes:
Composed of ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧ (garden/yard) + ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ (work). A straightforward compound referring to all types of work done in a garden.

USAGE:
{庭仕事|にわしごと} covers a broad range of activities including ⟦{草|くさ}むしり→草むしり：08195_kusamushiri⟧ (weeding), ⟦{剪定|せんてい}→剪定：06327_sentei⟧ (pruning), ⟦{水|みず}やり→水やり：06328_mizuyari⟧ (watering), ⟦{植|う}え{替|か}え→植え替え：08231_uekae⟧ (replanting), and ⟦{芝刈|しばか}り→芝刈り：08532_shibakari⟧ (mowing).
The ～⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ pattern is productive in Japanese for forming compound nouns: {力仕事|ちからしごと} (physical labor), ⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ (housework), {針仕事|はりしごと} (needlework).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {庭仕事|にわしごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do garden work
- {庭仕事|にわしごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{精|せい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to devote oneself to gardening
- {庭仕事|にわしごと}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手袋|てぶくろ}→手袋：01063_tebukuro⟧: gardening gloves

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ガーデニング→ガーデニング：07816_gaadeningu⟧: gardening — the loanword, often implies more ornamental or hobby-oriented gardening
- ⟦{園芸|えんげい}→園芸：04105_engei⟧: horticulture, gardening — a broader term that can include indoor plants and professional cultivation
- ⟦{草|くさ}むしり→草むしり：08195_kusamushiri⟧: weeding — one specific type of {庭仕事|にわしごと}
